summary: Team-oriented HR professional with a legal background, skilled in interpreting policies, delivering client service, and managing HR processes. Experienced in quantitative research, data analysis, and using HRIS systems such as PeopleSoft, SAP, and Remedy.

experience.title: HR Customer Service Representative
responsibilities: Responded to inquiries about HR policies and procedures via telephone, email, fax, and walk-ins.
Logged and tracked all queries in Remedy database to ensure quality assurance.
Liaised with HR, Visa, Payroll, Accounting, and Travel departments to deliver timely service.
Educated clients on self‑service options.
Contributed to knowledge base development.
Researched policies and federal guidelines to provide accurate responses.
Ran and analyzed daily reports to benchmark employee performance and compliance with the 2‑day Service Level Agreement.
Maintained task tracking and met deadlines and priorities.

experience.title: Consultant Project Manager
responsibilities: Authored policies and procedures and completed Department of Health licensing requirements for credentialing.
Wrote business correspondence and collected data for client database.
Organized client record filing and maintained client records.
Prepared appointment packages including salary, fringe benefits, and clearance processes.
Created employee file checklists for application submissions.
Prepared comprehensive materials for presentations.

experience.title: Liaison Officer
responsibilities: Organized presentations with business partners to achieve objectives.
Partnered with physicians to obtain prior authorizations for services.
Maintained and managed over 100 client accounts.
Ran reports to evaluate employee productivity and benchmark case‑load increases.
Liaised between clients, physicians, insurers, and management to suggest service improvements.
Communicated service‑related information to clients and upper management.
Provided feedback to promote quality service.
